text:
GENERATE BURST CS-neariso-bridge — ISOLATE one near-camera object from a painted game frame (R-C3-79). task_id "CS-neariso-bridge".

IMAGE 1 (1536×1024) is a hand-painted 2D ARPG frame containing the gnarled dark CLIFF-PINE BRANCH with needle clusters reaching in from the top-left corner, which passes close in front of the camera. Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 1 and deliver ONE 1536×1024 image in which ONLY that object stays EXACTLY as painted — same pixels, position, size, outline, colours, rim light and softness — and EVERYTHING else (the ground, cliffs, clouds, sky, background, the character, the bridge, the black bars) becomes flat PURE GREEN #00ff00 with a crisp edge against the object (no halo). Where the frame's border or the black bars cut the object, leave it cut straight (do not extend it). Gaps between needles/branches/rock become green. Nothing added, nothing moved.

One image_gen call. ONE retry only if the object moved or changed, anything else remains, or the green is not flat — name the reason. Copy the output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/neariso_bridge.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "CS-neariso-bridge"; images = the file with prompt, references and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.
